[DRAFT] TAX STRUCTURING TERM SHEET
For the Acquisition of Stock of [Target Corporation]
Date: [Insert Date]
Buyer: [Insert Buyer Name]
Seller(s): [Insert Seller Name(s)]
Target: [Insert Target Corporation Name]
Transaction: Acquisition of [all/substantially all] of the issued and outstanding shares of Target

1. Transaction Structure
    • Form of Acquisition: Purchase of [all/substantially all] of the issued and outstanding shares of Target from Seller(s).
    • Intended Tax Treatment: The parties intend for the transaction to be treated as a purchase of stock for U.S. federal income tax purposes.
2. S-Corporation Status
    • Representation and Warranty: Seller(s) shall represent and warrant that Target has made a valid S-corporation election effective as of [date], and that such election has been continuously in effect through the Closing Date, except as otherwise disclosed.
    • Disclosure of Questionable Status: Seller(s) acknowledge that the validity of Target’s S-corporation election is subject to uncertainty due to [describe issues, e.g., potential ineligible shareholders, defective election filings, or other factors].
    • Due Diligence: Buyer shall have the right to conduct tax due diligence regarding the S-corporation status of Target, including review of all relevant IRS filings, shareholder consents, and corporate records.
3. Tax Indemnity and Escrow
    • Indemnity for S-Status Issues: Seller(s) shall indemnify Buyer for any taxes, penalties, interest, or other losses arising from a determination that Target’s S-corporation election was invalid or terminated prior to Closing, including any resulting C-corporation level taxes.
    • Escrow: A portion of the purchase price equal to $[amount] or [percentage]% shall be placed in escrow for a period of [X] years post-Closing to secure Seller(s)’ indemnity obligations relating to S-corporation status and related tax matters.
4. Section 338(h)(10) Election (if applicable)
    • Election Option: The parties may agree to make a joint election under Section 338(h)(10) of the Internal Revenue Code, if Target’s S-corporation status is confirmed and all eligibility requirements are met.
    • Allocation of Tax Liability: The parties shall agree on the allocation of any resulting tax liability and benefits from the election, including responsibility for any corporate-level tax triggered by the deemed asset sale.
5. Pre-Closing Tax Returns
    • Responsibility: Seller(s) shall be responsible for preparing and filing all tax returns of Target for periods ending on or before the Closing Date, including any short-period returns.
    • Review Rights: Buyer shall have the right to review and comment on any such returns prior to filing.
6. Post-Closing Tax Matters
    • Cooperation: The parties shall cooperate in connection with any tax audits, examinations, or proceedings relating to periods prior to Closing.
    • Access to Records: Seller(s) shall provide Buyer with reasonable access to all tax records and information relating to Target for pre-Closing periods.
7. Other Tax Representations
    • No Built-in Gains Tax: Seller(s) represent that Target does not have any material built-in gains subject to Section 1374 of the Internal Revenue Code, except as disclosed.
    • No Disqualifying Events: Seller(s) represent that, to their knowledge, no events have occurred that would disqualify Target’s S-corporation status, except as disclosed.
8. Governing Law
    • This term sheet and any definitive agreements shall be governed by the laws of the State of [Insert State].

This term sheet is non-binding and for discussion purposes only. The terms herein are subject to the negotiation and execution of definitive agreements.

[Signature Blocks]

Key Notes:
    • This template is for general informational purposes and should be reviewed and customized by legal and tax counsel.
    • Special attention should be paid to the specific facts regarding the S-corporation status and any IRS guidance or case law relevant to the issues identified.
